expectations.text: Slide titles, hooks, and bullets are written in natural Hindi, not left in English or stiffly translated.
expectations.evidence: e.g. hook '30 दिनों में 12,000 डाउनलोड और 4.3 स्टार रेटिंग' and closing '—  टीम के शानदार काम के लिए धन्यवाद' read as natural Hindi phrasing, not literal translation.

expectations.text: Uses a theme with a Devanagari-capable font rather than the Latin-only presets.
expectations.evidence: Summary confirms an inline theme based on modern-dark with heading_font/body_font overridden to 'Nirmala UI'.

expectations.text: The two numbers (12,000 downloads, 4.3 rating) appear as a clear KPI-style callout.
expectations.evidence: Slide 2 kpi layout: '12,000 | कुल डाउनलोड', '4.3 ★ | औसत रेटिंग', '30 दिन | लॉन्च अवधि', with a one-line takeaway.

expectations.text: The deck is short per the explicit 'not too long, just the main points' request.
expectations.evidence: 3 slides total: title/hook, KPI, closing. No background or extra sections added beyond what was given.
